description: This file defines a registration system for flash attention implementations in PyTorch, including functions to register, activate, list, and restore implementations, as well as managing the current active implementation.

classes.name: FlashAttentionHandle
classes.description: Protocol defining a handle with a remove method to manage flash attention resources.

methods.name: register_flash_attention_impl
methods.description: Registers a flash attention implementation with a dispatcher function.

methods.name: activate_flash_attention_impl
methods.description: Activates a registered flash attention implementation.

methods.name: list_flash_attention_impls
methods.description: Returns a list of all available flash attention implementations.

methods.name: current_flash_attention_impl
methods.description: Returns the name of the currently active flash attention implementation, if any.

methods.name: restore_flash_attention_impl
methods.description: Restores the default FA2 flash attention implementation.
